study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Wu and Baeken, Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative modeling analysis reveals corpus callosum volume changes in early and mid-to-late first episode major depression

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Assess corpus callosum (CC) subvolume differences in first-episode MDD versus matched healthy controls using normative modeling, compare early-onset and mid-to-late-onset subgroups, and test associations with depression severity.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Spearman correlations between HAMD scores and CC z-scores (overall, early-onset, mid-to-late), with medication (yes/no) as covariate; FDR correction across CC subdivisions; group-level one-sample t-tests for mean z-score deviations and subgroup comparisons.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: First-episode MDD showed reduced CC volume (z-scores) overall and in the body versus norms; mid-to-late-onset patients showed significant CC and body reductions, while in early-onset patients higher depression severity correlated with increased CC, body, and splenium volumes.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Compared to healthy control norms, first-episode MDD exhibited significant z-score reductions in entire CC (p = 0.04) and CC body (p = 0.02, FDR-corrected). Mid-to-late onset showed significant CC volume decreases for entire CC (p = 0.02) and body (p = 0.01, FDR-corrected). In early-onset, depression severity correlated positively with entire CC z-scores (r = 0.15, p = 0.01), body (r = 0.15, p = 0.03, FDR), and splenium (r = 0.14, p = 0.03, FDR).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Education included as a fixed covariate and captured by the normative model; analyses performed at CC subvolume (ROI) level using JHU atlas; behavioral analyses in R with FDR control.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: No data on depressive episode duration; relatively small sample size for mid-to-late first-episode MDD subgroup.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Healthy controls selected from 7 sites. MRI acquisition parameters referenced to Yan et al. (2019). CC parcellation based on JHU DTI-based white-matter atlas. PCNToolkit v0.18 used for HBR normative modeling with fixed effects (age, sex, education, ICV) and site random effects.
